mini_lesson.simple_intro: Arabic Grammar, or Nahw, helps you make good sentences. It shows how words work together.
step_by_step_explanation: Nahw teaches how to join nouns, verbs, and particles.
It tells us about the last letter of words.
We use Nahw to speak and write Arabic right.

think_about_it.question: Why do we need Nahw?
think_about_it.answer: To make correct sentences and avoid mistakes.

try_it_yourself.task: Find a noun, verb, and particle in a sentence.
try_it_yourself.expected_answer: Example: دَخَلَ زَيْدٌ الدَّارَ. (Dakhala Zaydun ad-dara).
try_it_yourself.simple_reason: دَخَلَ is a verb, زَيْدٌ is a noun, and الدَّارَ is a noun with a particle.

tiny_recap: It teaches about words and sentences.
We use Nahw to speak Arabic well.

key_terms.example_from_text: what the إِعْرَابٌ (condition) of the last letter of a word should be.
Its subject matter is كَلِمَةٌ (word) and كَلَامٌ (sentence).

word_help.why_it_matters: It shows action in a sentence.

flashcards.back: Science of joining words to make correct sentences.
How to join nouns, verbs, and particles.

quiz.question: What is the main goal of Nahw?
quiz.simple_explanation: Nahw helps us join words correctly.

quiz.question: Nahw teaches us about numbers.
quiz.simple_explanation: Nahw teaches about words and sentences, not numbers.

mini_lesson.simple_intro: A word is called لَفْظٌ. If it means something, it is مَوْضُوعٌ. If not, it is مُهْمَلٌ.
step_by_step_explanation: Words can be مُفْرَدٌ (single) or مُرَكَّبٌ (compound).
There are three types of words: اِسْمٌ (noun), فِعْلٌ (verb), and حَرْفٌ (particle).
A noun is a word that makes sense alone and doesn't change with time.

think_about_it.question: Can you think of a noun?
think_about_it.hint: Think of a person, place, or thing.

try_it_yourself.task: Pick a noun from your surroundings.
try_it_yourself.simple_reason: It is a single word that makes sense alone.

common_mistake.correction: Words can be nouns, verbs, or particles.

tiny_recap: Words can mean something or nothing.
Words can be single or compound.
Nouns are words that make sense alone.

key_terms.example_from_text: Any word uttered by humans is called a لَفْظٌ.

key_terms.simple_explanation: A word that has a meaning.
key_terms.example_from_text: If it has a meaning, it is called مَوْضُوعٌ (meaningful).

word_help.why_it_matters: It is an example of a noun that makes sense alone.
It is another example of a noun.

quiz.question: What is a مُفْرَدٌ?
quiz.simple_explanation: مُفْرَدٌ means a single word that makes sense alone.

quiz.question: Nouns can have tanween and alif lam at the same time.
quiz.simple_explanation: A noun cannot have both tanween and alif lam together.
